The risks of widespread use of Los Evos are still being debated. However, the rapid spread of Infection X may soon force management to take drastic measures.

The operating principles of the emitters remain unknown. Further research is required. Precautions according to the Sierra-17 protocol must be observed. Highest safety class assigned pending further clarification.

Samples X-17, X-31 and X-44 demonstrated direct effects on biological tissues. A persistent tissue response to emissions is currently observed. Further testing with various voltage profiles is necessary. It would also be advisable to conduct a series of tests with a spectrum-splitter.

Although the operating principles of the devices remain unknown, some potential applications still appear quite realistic. Influencing emission parameters by exposing the device to gamma radiation and a magnetic field appears particularly promising.
An experimental device codenamed Suppressor demonstrates a clear and reproducible effect on infected tissue. It is preliminarily considered safe for healthy tissue.

Despite all the potential risks in terms of long-term consequences, the Suppressor appears to be the most promising means of combating Infection X. While concerns raised by some employees regarding secondary bursts in the radio-frequency range are worth considering, they do not constitute a significant argument against its use.
There are studies of the competitive relationship between the Infection X pathogen and the Tardifuma cestodes. Further research is needed.
Tardifumas are poorly adapted to survival in the human body. Even suppression of the immune system by the Infection X pathogen does not affect the survival rate of the test subjects.

Genetically modified specimens demonstrate improved survival rates in the human body. Furthermore, as a result of a side mutation Los Evos triggers a persistent immune response, affecting, among other things, the Infection X pathogen. Further research is needed.

In fact, seventh-generation Tardifumas are now capable of entering into a symbiotic relationship with the human body. The flagella they developed starting with the fourth generation are now capable of "fusing" with nerve endings and stimulating the hypothalamic-pituitary system.
An unknown fungus was discovered in sector D-17. The mycelium is dense, directed, and exhibits high resistance to external conditions. The structure appears organized, not chaotic.
The fungus penetrates tissue without causing significant damage. A form of symbiosis with the host organism is observed. The working name for this fungus is Los Evos.
The presence of Los Evos significantly slows the progression of Infection X. It likely suppresses or displaces the pathogen. It is being considered as a potential method of infection control.
Mycelium penetration into the nervous system has been confirmed. Connections with neurons are formed. Subjects are alive, but exhibit changes in behavior and reactions. The risks remain unclear.

english: Man, someone's tailing me, let me through quickly, I have a terrible feeling!
I have something much more convincing.
Greetings! And congratulations on your first day. Your job is quite simple: screen visitors according to the instructions you've received.

Remember, despite its simplicity the importance of your work cannot be overstated. So carefully review the instructions at the start of every day. The situation can change quickly, and so can the rules.
You don't need to worry about that for now. Instructions and visitors: that's all you need to know.
Got it. Sorry, what did you say your name was?
It doesn't matter. For you, I'm simply the Supervisor. There's no need to call me. I'll come to you myself when needed.
Glad to hear it. Good luck in your new job.
Greetings. Starting today, your clearance level has been upgraded. You can now visit the temporary-holding room. Or rather, you must.
It's simple: you need to make sure that the right people are there, and the wrong people are not.

It doesn't matter! I'll take care of the formalities. Oh, and you also need to... choose daily recreational activities for those who are temporarily isolated. Some activities may seem strange to you, but pay them no mind.
Okay... although that sounds a little strange...
It's in your best interest to avoid asking unnecessary questions. New duties mean a pay raise, of course. Have a nice and productive day!
Greetings. Since we... had an unexpected staff cut, your responsibilities have expanded again. Your security clearance has, of course, also been upgraded.
You now have access to the citywide monitoring interface and the right to authorize special measures and operations.
You'll watch the city and decide what the agents should do. As always, unnecessary questions are strongly discouraged. Is everything clear?
Greetings. As you know, certain processes are taking place in the city. It might not be obvious, but your work has a direct impact on them.
I want you to understand that you know as much as necessary. Perhaps in the future you'll be assigned other duties, with different levels of clearance and, of course, greater responsibility.
I hope so. Just try not to rush things. All in due time.

Interference! That means there's an anomaly somewhere. Find the area with the strongest interference and take a photo by clicking [LMB].

The photo is on your desk and will be developed soon. Sometimes they can contain things that aren't visible to the naked eye. When a visitor brings such an entity with them, you will get interference on the camera's screen. The closer the anomalous entity is to the edges of the frame, the stronger the interference. You have to send them to the isolation ward for further study!

Welcome to the isolation ward. Use [LMB] on any silhouette for information and interaction.
You can conduct one experiment per day to advance your understanding of anomalies. Press here to choose today's experiment.
The experiment will last all day. Perhaps tomorrow we'll know a little more about the anomalies. Press here to approve the experiment.
There's nothing more to do here today. Press here to leave the isolation ward.
Press here to go to the city screen.
This is the city operations screen. Here, you can see what's happening with the city, and the operations available to you.
An epidemic of an unknown disease is raging in the city. Given the high risk, reaching a critical point will call for...the most drastic measures.

english: The experiment proceeded normally, and no significant events were observed.
No experiments were conducted yesterday. Please note: the downtime of multifunctional isolation units may lead to adverse long-term consequences.
The test subjects displayed no reaction to the experiment. We recommend introducing a different lineup. The method of removing current subjects remains at the discretion of the authorized person.
Conducting an experiment in an empty isolation ward confirmed the hypothesis about the absence of invisible people, objects, otherworldly entities, and other imperceptible phenomena inside.
The exposure experiment proceeded as planned. The yellow color and shape of the object are believed to have a positive effect on the subjects' hormonal levels and mood.
The acoustic test yielded significant results: [redacted]. The subject's seven attempts to initiate a dance sequence during the experiment were decisively suppressed.
The experimental energy node elicited mixed reactions in the subjects. Spikes of activity across different brain regions, as well as increased motor function, were registered.

The experiment on long-term inhalation of the Lilac-8 gas was considered a success, despite the following observed side effects: cough, confusion, dizziness, itching, hallucinations, shortness of breath, weakness, panic attacks, bleeding from [redacted], tinnitus, grogginess, paranoid psychosis, swelling of the legs, aching joints, and flatulence.

The arithmetic test revealed the following pattern: prolonged staring at numbers triggers migraines and a persistent aversion to algebra in subjects. For further experiments, five-minute breaks involving exposure to music tracks or short-form videos are strongly recommended.
The experiment revealed the following pattern: prolonged exposure of subjects to water spraying in a confined space resulted in the subjects becoming very wet in the vast majority of cases.

The experiment revealed the following: prolonged stay in a confined space with an elevated temperature triggers profuse sweating in subjects. For further experiments, we recommend supplying subjects with deodorant in advance.

The experiment involving a prolonged stay in a low-temperature environment revealed the following reactions in subjects: chills, loud chattering of teeth, shrinking, convulsive rubbing of the body with the palms of the hands, unflattering comments about the management of [redacted], and demands to provide warm clothing and hot drinks (obviously ignored).

The experiment involving prolonged exposure to Quartz-12 lamps showed no significant changes in the subjects' health, either physical or mental. For further experiments, we recommend testing Quartz-12M, Quartz-9, Quartz-6/7, and Quartz-21 lamps.
Subject [redacted] committed the unauthorized dissection of the carotid arteries during the experiment.
Subject [redacted] complained of feeling unwell during the experiment, after which he suddenly died and became fungified.
During the experiment, subject [redacted] developed a severe allergic reaction that resulted in disfigurement and death.

During the experiment, subject [redacted] lost consciousness, fell to the floor, and experienced tonic seizures. Three minutes and twenty seconds later, he rose to his feet and attacked [redacted]. Personnel were ordered not to interfere. Subsequently, [redacted]...bodies were piled in a heap in the center of the room. Two hours later, unidentified luminescent fungi began to sprout through the bodies. It is recommended that the isolation ward be cleaned and treated with chemicals according to Form 10-14.

Subject [redacted] has undergone spontaneous mutation. Body elongation, changes to tissue structure, skin growths, and altered consciousness were observed. During the transformation, the subject attacked and absorbed [redacted]. You are ordered to study the subject for 24 hours, followed by termination. Exercise extreme caution.

The isolation ward is filled with organs and tissues that spontaneously grew out of subject [redacted]'s body. The subject supposedly retains formal signs of life. Recommended course of action: collect a histological specimen and conduct thermal treatment of the isolation ward.
During the experiment, the DUCC object spontaneously expanded to a critical size. Avoid using sharp objects during cleanup to prevent a potentially dangerous explosion.
During the experiment, the Tesla Globe overloaded, triggering a phenomenon known as a "resonance cascade." Perform cleanup using Barrier-114 protective suits.

Due to an experiment-induced "avalanche" of mutations and uncontrolled growth of biological tissue, the isolation ward is temporarily unavailable for new subjects and experiments. An emergency biohazard response team has been called to perform cleanup after hours.

During the experiment, a failure occurred in the cooling unit's control module, resulting in shock cooling of the isolation ward and the formation of large icicles. We recommend using the Cyclops laser system to fix the issue. Exercise caution.

The acoustic test using phonograph records found in the [redacted]...mansion resulted in the painful death of the subjects, with the formation of post-mortem shadow projections. It is strictly prohibited to interrupt the music until it finishes playing on its own and the projections fade.

Due to an equipment failure, the experimental gas Lilac-8 was injected at a concentration 47 times higher than intended. The test subjects are confirmed dead. The origin, nature, and intentions of the creatures observed in the isolation ward are unknown. A request has been sent to COMCON-1. Please stand by.

During the experiment, the subjects were spontaneously transported to an unknown point in space. This ejection point is presumably located outside the solar system. The nature of the cubic object that appeared in the isolation ward the moment the subjects disappeared is subject to investigation under the Horizon-97 protocol.

The explosive growth of fungi has been detected in the isolation ward. This is presumably due to the significant increase in humidity and the presence of the necessary nutrients in the test subjects' bodies. It is recommended that spore samples be collected and the ward purged.

For reasons unknown, a seed of the Marsian Mantrapper plant was present inside the isolation ward during the experiment. Exposure to quartz lamplight triggered a growth phase that lasted a record-breaking 7.5 minutes, after which the plant entered protein-diet mode. We recommend moving the plant to [redacted] while observing all necessary safety protocols.

During the experiment, spontaneous transformations of subjects to mimic the exposed object were observed. The causes, as with Event [redacted], are unknown. All available tests must be performed. Subjects are to be moved to [redacted] for long-term storage.

During the experiment, a brief blackout was recorded, during which objects visually identical to mannequins were moved into the isolation ward. The status of the test subjects is unknown. A detailed study of the objects is required, after which a decision will be made about their disposal or storage at [redacted] or [redacted].

During the experiment, a momentary voltage surge occurred in the Tesla Globe circuit, resulting in the destruction of the stabilizing coils, a breach in the insulating dome, and the subsequent uncontrolled release of the energy sphere into the isolation ward. Contact with the energy sphere must be avoided until it has discharged naturally.

During the experiment, thermal vortices of unknown origin formed. A detailed study of this phenomenon and its subsequent elimination is required. When collecting the remains of the test subjects, make sure to avoid dispersing or mixing them.

The experiment was interrupted due to the petrification of the subjects. According to the lab technician on duty, the culprit was, quote, "some kind of magic man in a robe, shouting 'petrificus' and shooting bright beams from his wand." Before sending the subjects to [redacted], all necessary tests (including blood and drug screening for the technician) must be performed.

Warning: The arithmetic test triggered the activation of a sleeper agent (subject under the fictitious name [redacted])! A neuroprogrammer from Section 48-91 of the Orwellian Foreign Intelligence Service is suspected of being involved. You are to exercise extreme caution until security eliminates the agent.

During the experiment, a conflict arose among the subjects over a discussion of recent sporting events. The research team made the decision not to involve security and continued the experiment. The conflict quickly escalated into a violent brawl, resulting in the death of all subjects from their injuries.

english: The Coming of the Ginger Colossus
The Conspiracy of the Order of Technomancers
Oooh... You're such a kawaii little startle-bug. We just wanna squish you! Can we? Can we???
Oh, I-I really don't know, not so fast...
Bro, don't even mind us. Chill, relax. We just like messing with you, though personally, we're against it.
No, child, only we are here. Be calm, there is no cause for worry.
How am I supposed to calm down? What do you mean, 'we'?!
Another one... Just how many of you are there?!
We hereby inform the subject that only two entities are present in this room: the guard and Machina Fatorum.
I still don't understand a thing...
Hey! Don't pile on our guy! He's a solid dude if he made it all the way to this frame!
We agree, there's no need to plunge the naive child into an abyss of confusion.
Uh... Thanks? I guess... But please, could one of you just explain all this properly?
We were about to, bro, it's just that we butted into our own conversation...
Aw, forgive-forgive, it's just he's got such kawaii little whiskers. We couldn't resist, forgive us.
We ask ourselves to be quiet. We will explain everything to the subject. Please, give us the floor.
And how are you going to explain anything by staying silent...?
The subject interpreted incorrectly; we will tell all while we stay silent.
Believe it or not, that didn't help.
The child is simply confused; it's hard for him to grasp our multidimensionality and our many faces.
We express gratitude to ourselves. So. We are known to your species by the code name Machina Fatorum.
You've got such boring little names!
Precisely. Our purpose is the preservation of humanity. However, humanity has taken the path of escalating the threat.
Extremely careless. But predictable for this species.
For this reason we are compelled to initiate an intervention, to integrate edits into this space-time.
So that cuties like you can finally breathe easy.
For a three-dimensional being, yes. The subject has nothing to worry about. Our authority permits this intervention.
Well... I suppose it's not like I have a choice.
Though I really can't figure out... What do I have to do with any of this?
For the fruit to touch your hands, child, the soil must be prepared.
And besides, bro, we figured we oughta get acquainted with such a stand-up guy. Wouldn't be proper otherwise.
So I was helping you through the operations?
No-no-no!!! We don't want to leave the cutie here. It'll be boring without him!
Agreed! We gotta take our bro with us! Besides, explaining it all again is such a hassle.
The child will help us search for the right outcome.
The interface is prepared, we will initiate the exit.
We shared a tiny little piece of our existence with you, sweetie-pie. You performed your duties so adorably!
And why are you talking to me on little scraps of paper...
Because that's how you like it, buddy.
Now now, cutie pie, don't get distracted! Look here.
Well... I understand that this is the sequence of my shifts. But where's the parallel here...?
Possibility gives rise to existence, child; you'll understand soon.
Bro, now take a look over here.
For such a cutie, we've put together a handy set of your human little pictures here. Otherwise you wouldn't understand our multidimensional data at-all-at-all.
Looks...extremely informative. Like floating computer windows.
We ask the subject to note the three lower buttons.
This path grants you the ability to correct what has been done.
Like grinding it out again if you messed something up, bro.
Now isn't that wonderful? A parallel universe, cutie.
The subject must note this counter. The number of simultaneously connected branches is limited.
We don't want our cutie pie to lose his mind, after all. Now pick a brand-new old universe.
See, bro, a perfect copy. But you and us both know how it all ends. So no point squandering the connections, smash it right here.
This little button, you'll have to hold down. Otherwise the cutie pie might accidentally forget something he didn't at-all-at-all mean to forget.
Oh! It's gone! Did I...destroy a universe?!
Easy, child, closing your eyes does not destroy reality. Sometimes you simply have to forget something old to find something new.
The brief tour is complete. The search algorithm is elementary. The subject must seek an outcome that satisfies the objectives.
Yes-yes, cutie, it's all simple. You just tear open a collapsed probability, and if you don't like something, you set the junk adrift.
Well, bro, there's no other way. If you want to save humanity, you'll have to become a hero known only to us.
Hmm... Create a new universe to try a different solution to the problem... I sort of get it, and I sort of feel my head's about to explode...
Ooh! Floating droplets of melted brain! That sounds soooo cuuute!!!
We ask ourselves to keep our fondnesses to ourselves. Such a display of physics does not satisfy us!
May your path be true, child.
Yo, bro. We were starting to think you wouldn't show.
Cutie pie's here, so he managed to settle in. And those little eyes are still so kawaii-confused!
Yeah, I still feel off, honestly.
We understand, child. An insight that nature never granted dazzles brighter than the stars.
That's putting it mildly... And still... Did I do everything right this time?
We hereby inform the subject that the probability of deviation from the required sequence of actions approaches zero.
That's a relief. Alright then, go on, fix whatever needs fixing.
Very well, impatient child, we begin.
What the?! You said I was doing everything right!!!
True, child. The true path of the search is the path of mistakes.
Bro, we told you, we're not all-powerful.
Meanie!!! We're trying our hardest for him here, helping him fix his mistakes, and he's a grumbly-grumps!
Do you even have any idea...
A question in return for the subject: does the subject have any idea what a drone in a beehive experiences?
Well, neither do we, bro, we've no idea what it's like for you. If you're tired and giving up, we can toss you back.
N-no need! Okay. I get it. Will it at least work this time?
Alright, bro, easy, it'll all happen in a sec, don't freak out.
Well, what can I say... long time no see?
Has the cutie pie thought about his behavior?
Yeah. I lost my temper for nothing, I admit it.
As if I have a choice... Like they say, adapt or die.
Well, bro, there's definitely a choice, if...
I'm not tired! Don't put me back. I don't want it all to be for nothing.
We confirm, the subject's attitude is favorable. Probability of success is high.
Heartening to hear, child, you are rising above your former self. Keep it up when this is all over.
Fair enough. This journey has taught me a lot. But let's not drag it out.
Oooh... Our cutie doesn't enjoy our company? Fine, fine, we begin!
I've kinda gotten used to it, even a little. I treat it like a game where you can save and replay the levels.
Child, that sounds irresponsible... Even we don't allow ourselves such a thing...
Come on now, let's not pile on him.
We rightly observe, this is a typical defensive reaction for this species.
Well, maybe so. But I'm curious. What happens to the universes I forget?
And what happens to the kitty you once happened to see on the street, kitty-cat?
I get what you're driving at. But I mean specific ones. What happens to them now?
Well, for example, the one where I was sitting at the desk and...well...uhh... Damn! I sit at the desk everywhere...
Never mind... Doesn't matter, my head's a mess anyway...
There we go, cutie. Don't clutter your little head with junk, or you'll turn boring.
What's wrong, cutie? Are you not the right cutie? Uh-oh-oh...
The place is correct. An error is highly unlikely.
Ha! Gotcha! You fell for it. Caught you there.
A knife in the back, and from our bro! Oh, you're good! Respect to you!
Child, we completely fail to understand this human lying... Why?
So you don't get too comfortable. Keeping you on your toes.
We have no toes. And no muscle tone to maintain.
Come on, what's with us? It was a good prank. Bro, well done, we're rooting for you!
Yes-yes, cutie, you little sweetie pie, you had us so worried. But be more careful, what if our little heart can't take it.
Don't worry. I'm easy to find, hard to lose, and impossible to forget.
Okay-okay-okay, cutie, don't take offense. We're starting now.
Hey. Honestly, I'm starting to lose hope.
You sure, bro? Really losing it? Really, hope?
Lost it?! Where?! A loss! Not a process!
The child is saying that his soul is ceasing to see the ray of light.
We notify the subject that there is always a chance as long as the subject searches. Ceasing the search is equivalent to reducing the chance to zero.
Well... I mean... That's true, too, of course.
No! Definitely not! That's enough, nothing happened. I just had to catch my breath a little.
Child, where do your thoughts wander? Is something troubling you?
I'm NOT tired!!! It's something else. I... How do I put this...
After all this, I'm not sure that I'm me. Everything is too...unreal.
Oh, cutie, don't pay it any mind. We've been through it ourselves.
Yeah, bro, we feel you there. Don't sweat it, it'll pass with time.
The subject has nothing to worry about. The phenomenon has a limited period of effect.
And still... Since you've been through this... Where is the real me?
Child, recall your childhood. You were different then. Does that make the past any less real?
Every moment you vanished and were born anew in time, without paying it the slightest attention. Has anything really changed?
Well... To put it mildly, a lot... Though...in truth everything stayed the same, just different.
Damn, I'm starting to talk like you now!
Soooo cuuute!!! Whiskers is learning from us!!! Incredibly cute!!!
And we always knew that you and us, bro, are on the same wavelength!
Some wavelength. I'd call it a tsunami. And I really hope that this time, at least, the tide finally goes out.
Alright! This is the last option! If this combination isn't the one either, I'll despair!
And a little hello to you too, cutie!
The subject has nothing to worry about. We are examining only this segment of frames. If it exhausts itself, we will begin exploring another.
Verily, child, as long as we are with you, the light will not fade. We are certain you will not lose hope.
Wait, wait... Are you saying that if we fail, we'll just start rolling back even further?
No! That's not cool at all! I signed up to be a guard, not a web browser!
Enough! Stalling! Irritating! We begin! Integration!
All knowledge is gathered. There is now enough information for the deconstruction and deserialization of the spatial manifestation.
We want our normal cutie-guardie back! We want-want-want.
Agreed, giving our bro the runaround isn't honorable!
Rejoice, child, for the light has gathered into a single ray.
Yes-yes, cutie, now we can remove the very thing it all started with!
Yep, for real, bro, we'll deal with the root of the problem.
And what's this root of the problem, anyway?
What do you think yourself, cutie?
To be rid of the consequences, one must eliminate the cause, correct.
So why didn't you just delete the disease?
Ah, right, makes sense. You're a so-so medic...
Look at that, the cutie's little teeth have come in, he bites!
You, bro, just... Do the whatsit... Actually, don't!
We hereby inform the subject of the fact that in dissection we have no equal!
Right, God's gift to pathology, sure.
Alright, alright, I hear you. So what knowledge did you gather?
A thread from every corner of the world, child.
Whiskers, don't trouble your head, you wouldn't understand anyway.
Yeah, bro, that stuff'd blow your lid clean off. You don't need it.
Hmm... Well, I suppose so. Considering all these multidimensions still give me the creeps...
Exactly, cutie. You get it yourself. And we wish you no harm, so we won't tell.
So... What now? You'll fix everything?
I really hope so. And so, I take it, we'll never see each other again?
Bro, we always see each other.
Yep-yep, in your little heart we're forever, cutie.
Well, this I definitely won't forget... I can't even imagine how I'll go on living an ordinary life...
Child, you took a guard job in a place like this... Your life is already anything but ordinary.
Hard to argue with that... And still... Where are you from?
Child, it's far too long a story. You wouldn't live to the end. The human existence is far too brief.
Come on, bro, it's time to say goodbye.
Aww, theeere it is. Time for the cutie pie to go. Boo-hoo! We'll remember you!
Yes, child, enjoy your worldly life, you've earned it.
The subject may consider himself a hero. But the subject had best keep quiet about his heroism. Others won't understand.
So. It's done, sweetheart. That cutie AM0N won't be able to hold the coherence of its little nodes anymore.
Check it out, this one's so happy he isn't even moving!
Gratitude! Give it! Now! To us!
The whiskered cutie pie really has frozen in this adorable pose.
We hereby inform our own inattentive selves that absolutely everything has frozen, without exception.
Let's fire up our multidimensional contraption, quick! Can't even enjoy the moment here!
Did the naive child imagine the result would change without a cause?
This whiskered fella still hasn't figured out that the bet won't pay off without all the trump cards.
Maybe the cutie just likes standing there like a silly little statue?
If the child is tired, one can always take a rest beside the River of Ages.
So what're we waiting for? Care to tell us?
We pay it no mind; it makes no difference when the process itself is beautiful.
We simply contemplate the moment when everything froze.
We ask ourselves not to waste space-time and to continue the search.
The changes are integrated. The probability of disrupting or blurring personal boundaries is zero.
So, whiskered cutie pie, proud of yourself?
YOU, who else!! Quit stalling! What's the matter with you?!
Child, tell us you're joking, we beg you...
Now then! We're asking it wrong. We'll show how it's done.
Who was it that handled all that paper-pushing to solve the problems?
There! Good! And this very guard, what sort of guy is he?
If you don't praise yourself, no one will, right, cutie?
Enough, he's playing dumb far too adorably. We can't take it anymore, we're about to melt!
And here you are again, naive child...
Who's to blame? Blame for what?
The guard-subject is to blame. He is charged with wasting space-time!
A hero who lost himself in the abyss of his own self... Woeful.
Whoop! Well then, we've dealt with the little problem of the uninvited life forms.
Guess we kinda overdid it there.
That turned out awkward... But he's such a little sweetie right now.
Hey, what are we on about? What sweetie? We don't agree with this nonsense!
Well, we didn't ask us! A sweetie, and that's final!
We fully agree with ourselves, we must seek other answers.
Child, can it be that your mind is screaming in agony?
Oh, look! He's a little sweetie again! So naive. Did he think something had changed?
We hope the child won't make us behold this agony again...
Exorcizamus te, omnis immundus spiritus, omnis satanica potestas...
Omnis incursio infernalis adversarii, omnis legio, omnis congregatio et secta diabolica.
Just reciting a bit, to strip all that half-witted gibberish of its meaning.
Ah. Got it. Yeah, those mushroom folk still give me the creeps.
Rejoice, child, for minstrels shall compose legends of our deeds.
Pathos can't decide anything, it doesn't even exist. What's the point of wasting energy on it?
You tell us, whiskered cutie pie. Why do you humans keep making art?
How should I know? A pointless waste of energy. And resources.
Hey! Are you trying to mock us?!
Now a good meal and a nap in a soft little bed, now that's a joy, yeah!
We do not complain, child. It is but one of your worldly facets. So kindly answer: What do you go by?
Well, usually by foot. Strange question...
Look at that, the cutie's sense of humor has come in.
A sense can't 'come in'; you're talking nonsense.
Strange! Suspicion! Traffic light! The rules! Name them!
There's one rule: to glow in different colors.
Regrettable, everything is devoid of meaning...
It's amazing you understand words at all, cutie. Must be our closeness.
The search! Has! Meaning! Another! Plane!
Why blindly follow the beaten road that leads nowhere...
Oh, the whiskered cutie pie just wanted to feel our unusual closeness again!
There was a problem, I solved it. What questions could you have for me?
And so the little tale ends, and whoever listened is a fine friend.
Finally. I was starting to think the world had gone insane.
It had, at that. But we sorted it all out.
And how does the child plan to set body and spirit in order?
Come on, cutie pie, give it a think, use your imagination.
Uh... How do I do that?
Look who you're asking... A workplace comedian. We'll have a word with management, and you'll be fired.
Don't!!! I'm serious, I have absolutely no idea what you mean!
I do! Can you swing it?
Management will heed our recommendation. Name your desired sum.
Well... More than now, I guess.
And what does the child intend to spend this 'more' on?
Then what do you even need the dough for?
I... I don't know. I feel off somehow.
Ooo... Nah, pal, this won't do.
Never mind. There's not enough information. We need to choose a different path.
We were waiting for you, child...
Yep! What'll you have for breakfast, cutie?
Picture it! A beach! Waves! Little fish! Swimming!
My head's starting to ache for some reason...
The sea breeze sweetly tickles your kawaii little nose!
Suddenly a water kitty rises from the sea and purrs adorably across the whole beach!
Next time the subject will think before wasting space-time!
Matter! Information! Transformation! Forbidden! The boundary!
Cutie-pie, you tried so hard. We're sure you've earned a promotion!
Like, climb up on a crate?
That's not what we mean, silly little cutie pie. To stop being just a guard.
What else would I be? I've always been a guard and always will be.
Self-critical, child... But you could become head of security...
So you plan to croak as a plain old guard, too?
I don't plan on dying. The dying are the ones who die.
We register a thoroughly unhealthy, radical fatalism. Please notify us of the Coordinator's whereabouts.
Well, he's wounded, so he's always on sick leave bleeding out.
Child... This won't do... Your thoughts are sick, and your body weeps with exhaustion. Healthy sleep will cure it...
People sleep on the other side of the planet, where it's night. Here it's day.
Well, how else would it be.
How, how... Ugh... Through a different outcome, bro.
Well, howdy, natural-born guard. Not tired of grinding away?
The tired are the ones who get tired.
The cutie pie's at it again... so kawaii-hopeless!
Ah, we get it now! This sly little rascal is just scared of getting fired!
I can't be fired, I'm a guard.
That's just the thing, cutie! Right, we're firing you from this iteration, you sneaky little smart aleck!
Stillness in the mind will now grant the bliss of serenity.
Yeah, complete lunatics, their brains got well and truly fried.
Oh sure, let's complain now that rusty nails in the brain lead to madness. What could possibly go wrong...
Is your heart weeping over the number of victims?
Well now... Are you depressed or something?
We register monotone speech, cause unknown.
I assure you, I'm perfectly fine.
Alright, alright. By the way, bro, we reckon you'll get promoted after this.
Though before this you only got... DEMOTED! Get it, huh!
Crafting human jokes is an incredibly laborious process for us. The subject is devaluing our labor!
You could at least laugh, cutie. That brick where your little face should be isn't cute at-all-at-all.
Hypothesis confirmed. In fact, no one really will go crazy anymore.
But this outcome isn't cute in the slightest!!!
Seems like an ordinary outcome to me.
No. We need more data. Let's try a different outcome.
Nature can't make mistakes, because it has no goal.
I'm just speaking the language of facts.
This is the most boring outcome! Not cute at-all-at-all-at-all!!! We continue the search for a cute path!
We failed to identify the hackers, but now no one will be able to impose their will on anyone anymore!
Yes! Hooray! This is a victory! Honestly, that was scary. Oxygen by subscription... Who could dream that up...
We think that after all this, the child has earned a vacation!
Yes! I should file for time off.
Then we won't keep you, child. We've done good work.
So why're you just standing there? Wanna chat some more?
No. I want to go and file for time off.
We hear you perfectly well, but we hereby inform you that making such decisions is beyond our authority.
I want to take a step.
Oooh! The cutie wants to take his first little step! Come on, Whiskers, we believe in you!!!
I want to, but I can't... I'm scared!
I want to calm down! I can't!!! I'm so scared!!!
Uh-oh...No one to anyone, then... The cutie pie can't even impose his own will on himself.
So scared!!! Help me!!! I'm begging you!!!
Howdy! Okay, a joke. A guy puts on a hat, and it fits him just right.
Haha... Damn, that's...HAHAHA...not that funny a joke...HAHAHAHA!
Whiskers is splitting his little sides so adorably. So kawaii when he hasn't the will to stop!
This is what happens, child, when you leap into the abyss where you've already died.
Hahahaha!!! Stop it! Hahaha!!! I get it, I get it!!!
And... Done! No more unauthorized collectives on our shift!
If you ask us, they were rather cute. But no matter, it's all behind us now.
Buddy, show a little more confidence, you did save humanity, after all!
Modesty is truly a virtue, child, but it's wretched to devalue your own deeds.
No, I'm serious, so I saved humanity, so what? I don't know it from Adam...
The main thing is I saved myself.
Our modest little cutie pie has turned into a grumpy egoist, would you look at that.
Your family! Can! Be proud! Of you!
I don't know my family either. Why do you keep listing off strangers to me?
What business is it of yours?
Bro, we kinda saved humanity together. We're a team, more or less.
I don't understand what you're trying to tell me. I got rid of a threat. You got rid of a threat. That's all.
Oooh! Meanie!!! What about our bond?! You don't value our closeness at all! Nasty!
Then we propose that we continue the search for a bright outcome.
Well, hello there, radical egocentrist. Nasty!
Why are you insulting me right off the bat?
Well, you don't think about others... Nasty little monkey!
Who says I don't? I do.
Oh! Do tell? And whom does the cutie pie think about?
Kawaii!!! You've finally admitted you can't help thinking about us. Cute-cute-cute!!!
And that's all, child? What about the Coordinator?
What's there to think about him? He's not here.
Ah, no, our mistake, nasty! Restart!

english:
The isolation ward is where you run experiments that advance your research into the anomalies. An experiment takes one day.
Current progress is shown on the bars in the bottom right corner of the screen.
The further your research into an anomaly progresses, the more city operations you unlock that use that anomaly to solve the problem.
Experiments vary in how effectively they advance research into each anomaly. The only way to find out is by scientific trial and error.
In some cases, a large concentration of anomalies of the same type combined with a particular experiment can lead to unforeseen consequences that set off the alarm in the isolation ward.
If the alarm goes off, the isolation ward is closed to you for one day.
The experiments you run also affect the subjects' mood. A subject under severe stress may take their own life or trigger a large-scale event that sets off the alarm.
The isolation ward's capacity is limited. You can increase it with upgrades bought at the end of a shift.
Any character held in the isolation ward can be released or eliminated. To do so, select them and press the corresponding button.
You can also purge the isolation ward entirely with the red button in the bottom left corner of the screen.

Green icons mark potential solutions.
If the problem bar (the red one) reaches the skull marker, you lose.
In this mode, your task is to run operations in the city, building up the solution percentage and driving the problem percentage down to zero.
The green bar shows the combined percentage of all potential solutions.
Together, the bars show the tug of war between the problem and the potential solutions. The problem and solution percentages can never add up to more than 100%, so over time they push each other out (solutions take percentage away from the problem, and vice versa).
The winning solution is the one with the highest percentage at the moment the problem is fully eliminated.
Early operations are not very effective, so you need to run experiments on the subjects in the isolation ward to unlock new, specialized, more effective ones.
Tip: The most effective strategy is to focus on one specific solution, both in the isolation ward and in city operations.

english: Oh, so you're the new guard everyone's been talking about?
Everyone! My colleagues, the walls, the voices in my head! Just kidding! Walls can't talk!
Oh, my name is Walter Weiss. But my colleagues call me Doctor Geiserveldt.
Thank you. Well, I'm actually here with a small request, and a very well-paid one at that!
It's very important to me that this young man clear your thorough screening.
And I'm not asking you to! Well, I won't keep you!
Guard! I knew you and I would get along! As promised, a token of my sincere gratitude.
You know, there's a saying: similia similibus curantur. Like cures like.
And what are you getting at?
I mean the cure for an unknown infection may turn out to be a perfectly well-known one. Parasites, fungi... the point is to study them! Science, goddammit! Anyway, I have to run...
I thought you and I had an understanding...
True enough. Well, I'll be knocking on your door again, so to speak. Be seeing you!
We meet again, guard! I must report at once that a monstrous error has been made! Your instructions require you to... stop anyone with a skull mark on their papers.
However, I need those people downstairs in one piece, not in a body bag, so to speak! So please, let them through without the usual... formalities.
I'm glad you're someone I can rely on.
You know, all this mysticism, the rituals... as a scientist I'm against all of it. But those blue glycosynthium crystals... there really is something magical about them!
Roughly speaking, the crystals are a very particular form of carbohydrate. Some colleagues believe they can be used to create... a primitive life form of sorts.
Obedient, controllable, and strong enough to solve a certain problem that's brewing. Anyway, I have to run. Try not to get sick.
Fair enough. Try not to get sick.
Still, people are a lot more reliable than that nondescript gray substance.
And what IS that gray goo?
Ferrosludge? Put simply, it's the offspring of a sinful union between liquid metal and a computer. Imagine mercury you could program.
Who knows, maybe one day we'll mold something human-shaped out of it. Never tires, pours itself straight through a chain-link fence... Liquid nitrogen, though. That could be a problem.
Well, I've talked your ear off. Good day to you.
These damned insects are going to drive me out of my mind!
Who else would I mean? The lab techs affectionately call it the corpse-eater. Those creatures really do help with our little necro-problem, but God, they are vile...
Well, I've talked your ear off. See you around.
Good answer, guard! Now listen up. Your country needs you to do your duty today even better than your instructions require!
That pretty boy doesn't know the first thing about security! Skin anomalies call for the most serious measures, not just "denied access"! You see anomalies on the skin, you call security, son!
Excellent work, son! Here's your compensation for those idiotic fines!
Excellent! And remember: the only things that will help us fight this disease are lead and advanced technology. Mushrooms, worms—that's all egghead nonsense!
And these techno-gizmos, they're not dangerous?
Of course they're dangerous! Like any other weapon. It all depends on whose hands it's in and whom it's pointed at. Anyway, no time to stand around jawing. At ease!
I'm disappointed! From now on I expect a lot more hustle out of you!
At ease, guard! I'll be brief: I need you to photograph every visitor coming in!
But there's nothing about that in the instructions...
Because the instructions are written by people with their brains on sideways! New ones every day. Complete insanity!
But never mind, I'll bring order to this place yet! And for that I need photographs of everyone: man, spider, alien, anyone at all! Do it!
Excellent work! Here, reimbursement for the film.
It was no trouble at all...
You know how to follow orders, and I appreciate that. Let's hope the Steel Units prove just as dutiful.
Yes, our future pride and joy. Robotic combat platforms. Real war machines! They're the key to victory over our uninvited guests.
You mean the flying saucer in the sky?
Who the hell else? Our uninvited guests won't be hanging in our sky much longer! Anyway, I'm out of time. At ease!
Are you angling for a sabotage charge?
Yes, that lets you off the hook. For now...
Guard, attention! Your country needs your help!
Quiet! You've got a syringe and a microscope. I want you to print out the erythrocytes of every single visitor! Those are the round red things. Everybody's got them in their blood.
To hell with the instructions! Just do what I told you! This is a matter of survival!
Excellent! Now he won't be able to hide from us!
Never mind. Although you have proven yourself reliable... All right, I think the Machina Fatorum is playing its own game. Whose bright idea was it to fight one rogue machine with another machine?!
Anyway, thanks to the right people we now have an alternative way to solve the problem. The whole damn mess comes down to the right man's not being in the right place at the right time.
And how do we fix that?
By making sure he is. The time and place are already set. And thanks to your help the right man will soon be found, too. And listen, keep your mouth shut. It's in your own interest. At ease!
Do you even realize you could have fixed everything?
Yeah, yeah, yeah, following the instructions! Now go live in the damned world you built!
The Great Mushroom speaks to you through my mouth! Don't eat the little mushrooms! Don't eat the yellow snow! And then the little mushrooms will help you!
Not so fast, Deskcap! There's a job for you. Do it and you'll get a bit of money! And I'll tell you a secret!
Microchips are wicked, the little mushrooms don't like them. Especially in the blood. Today you're told to let such folk through. Don't you do it! Send them packing, or better yet—kill them!
I'll give you money! I'll tell you a secret!
The little mushroom is pleased! Here's your money. And the secret! Are you listening?
The path you're on doesn't lead to the Great Mushroom! Feed the little mushrooms a little worm, then the Great Mushroom will awaken and come into the world! You can still take that path!
I didn't get a word of that...
You've upset the little mushrooms, oh, how you've upset them...
The Great Mushroom speaks to you through my mouth! He's offering a bit of money for a favor!
The Great Mushroom is calling his children! If you see a little mushroom under the skin, you give it a poke with the needle! I'll give you money, lots of money!
The little mushroom is pleased! Here's your money. And one more thing, listen carefully!
Don't believe in machines! They don't always do what you want. Not even what they were told to do.
Don't let a machine make your fate! Believe in the Great Mushroom, only he will help! And don't eat the yellow snow!
Excuse me, sir, who are YOU?!
I am nothing. I am the shadow of the Worm.
The ignorant ones who hide beneath the earth cannot grasp the wisdom of the Ancient. But to you is offered the great honor of tasting a grain of that wisdom.
And here's me thinking you'd be offering money...
That shall not be wanting. The Ancient is rich, the Ancient is generous. The Worm knows: today you kill those with the skull on their papers, and let through those with runic symbols.
Invert what is commanded! Do not kill those who bear the skull. Do not let through those who bear runic symbols!
The Ancient is pleased with you, mortal. Receive your reward. And hearken to the wisdom of the Worm!
Sure, go on, let's hear it.

The Ancient has been warring with the Foul Mushroom since time immemorial. And with the cadavers that the blue crystals can raise. And with those sorcerers who made of their own bodies an instrument of magic...
Wait, does this have something to do with the anomalies we're studying in the isolation ward?
Just so, mortal. The Ancient knows that all his enemies are being studied here, in hope of an alliance against the Worm. Remember, it is in vain!
Do not carry out their orders, do not send agents into the city, do not help them study the forbidden.
And if you do not hinder the Ancient as he claims his power, his hand shall be laid upon you first!
A tempting offer, to be sure...
It is a great honor. Do not forget that.
You dare defy the Ancient, mortal? Your folly shall not go unnoticed.
Hearken, mortal, to the voice of the Worm.
The Ancient sleeps in the depths of the earth, but his will is strong!
A favor. The reward shall be generous!
Generous rewards—now those I like! I'm listening.
People come to you with fragments of the Ancient slumbering under the skin. The ignorant call them larvae, parasites. Awaken them! A touch of the needle shall suffice.
Awaken the slumbering fragments of the Worm, and you shall have your reward.
The Ancient is pleased with you, mortal. Receive your reward. And hearken to the wisdom of the Worm!
The cunning Machine sits in the weave of fates, a spider in its web. The Ancient knows what lies beyond. The hour shall come when he takes all that is into his embrace.
Believe not false seers. Only he who walks every path himself can know the truth.
I'll pretend I understood all that...
You dare resist the will of the Worm, mortal? Your stubbornness shall lead you into an abyss of despair that you can neither describe nor even comprehend!

Interesting fact: For the employee's convenience, after long deliberation and no small amount of trial and error we have developed an incredibly convenient storage point for the instructions, so that they no longer occupy space on the desk. You can stow them away and retrieve them as required.
Unsolicited advice: Checking anomalies against the instructions can be extremely important. Don't forget you have that option whenever you're in doubt. All for the sake of your efficiency.

Damn, the instructions change so fast, and there's no rhyme or reason to it. You never know if you're going to die or get a golden ticket... Feels like we get new bosses every single day, each one with their own ideas. Or maybe things really are that unpredictable...

The previous guard always checked everyone against the instructions from top to bottom. I kept telling him it was faster the other way around, bottom to top, in order of priority! But he wouldn't listen. And where is he now? Nobody knows... [A Well-Wisher]
A guy I knew let himself go, stopped looking after his sanity entirely. Now... now he's gone. The Area will swallow you whole and won't even choke... [A Well-Wisher]
Fungi, parasites, alien technology... Are we really trying to use all of it indiscriminately as a cure? I'd hate to imagine how desperate management must be.

An acquaintance of mine ended up in the isolation ward once... He said the music in there was excellent, but it felt like being inside somebody's stomach. So that's what it is... the Area's stomach. Digesting everything down into numbers, percentages...
A doctor I know once poked a needle into a strange thing in a patient's hand and [CONTINUED IN SOURCE]

Please be advised that, unfortunately, owing to an insufficient budget for new furniture only the blood tests that are strictly required will be laid out each day. Do not be alarmed if some appear to be missing. An employee has simply exchanged one type of test for another prior to the shift.
Small talk is usually just a formality. But every so often a visitor lets slip something that really matters. [A Well-Wisher]
Word is that some of the microelements in the blood can interact with each other and mutate. I haven't seen it myself, but I caught the scientists talking about it over lunch.
They say some kind of red panda has hit the shelves, and if you pet it long enough it calms you down. I think it's all nonsense, but you never know...
I think I've gotten hooked on that red panda. Each time I have to pet it longer than the last, but damn it all, I can't stop.

Good thing management finally reworked the elevator so you can pick and choose who rides down. Used to be, if you rode down with an anomalous visitor that was a death sentence. Although... word is they never did take out the mass-elimination equipment...
